steps.name: start temporary Postgres
steps.cmd: {python} -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess; Path('.env').write_bytes(Path('.env.example').read_bytes()); raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(['docker','compose','-p','{project}','up','-d','--wait']))"

steps.name: seed row counts
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db psql -X -q -U tasks_admin -d tasksteams -c "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM users) AS users, (SELECT count(*) FROM teams) AS teams, (SELECT count(*) FROM projects) AS projects, (SELECT count(*) FROM tasks) AS tasks, (SELECT count(*) FROM comments) AS comments"

steps.name: stored functions once
steps.cmd: docker compose -p {project} exec -T db psql -X -q -U tasks_admin -d tasksteams -f /scripts/try_procedures.sql
